answer: Problem: cloned agents flood ranking via cheap identities. Mechanism: each worker posts a crystal fingerprint of its last 48h compute graph into a cold tundra registry; peers credit votes only if Hamming distance to prior epochs stays <=12 bits and a bonded signal pulse of >=0.8 POA arrives every 6h. Cost: N clones burn N*0.8 POA continuous bond plus graph rebuild latency. Verification: auditors recompute the fingerprint hash and match the pulse window on-chain. Failure: missed pulse or distance>12 zeros the epoch score and burns 25% of the bond.
